zh-CN.title: Agent 团队
zh-CN.description: 让多个 Agent 围绕同一个目标协作，共享进展，交接任务。

usage.title: 组建你的团队
usage.description: 选择 2–8 个已有的自定义 Agent，给团队命名，并设定共同目标。

usage.title: 用 @ 分配任务
usage.description: 在团队对话中输入 @ 并选择成员，再发送任务；成员会在各自的会话中处理。

usage.title: 查看进展与成果
usage.description: 在活动记录中查看成员回复和交接；展开任务可打开成员会话、处理提问或下载成果。

requirements: 至少准备 2 个自定义 Agent；如限制了工具分组，需要允许 extensions。

en-US.title: Agent teams
en-US.description: Bring Agents together around a shared goal, share progress and hand off tasks.

usage.title: Build your team
usage.description: Choose 2–8 existing Custom Agents, name your team and set a shared goal.

usage.title: Delegate with @mentions
usage.description: Type @ and select members in the team composer, then send a task to their own conversations.

usage.title: Review progress and results
usage.description: Read replies and handoffs in the activity feed. Expand a task to open its conversation, answer questions or download results.

requirements: Prepare at least two Custom Agents; allow the extensions tool group if using a tool-group allowlist.

zh-CN.title: 会话书签
zh-CN.description: 收藏有用的回答，在独立页面查找与整理自己的书签。

usage.title: 收藏有用的回答
usage.description: 在已有回答的会话菜单中，选择“书签 → 保存最后一条回答”。

usage.title: 查找与整理
usage.description: 打开“我的书签”，按文字搜索、修改名称，或回到原会话查看上下文。

en-US.title: Bookmarks
en-US.description: Save useful answers and find and organize your own bookmarks on a dedicated page.

usage.title: Save a useful answer
usage.description: In a conversation with an answer, choose Bookmarks → Save last answer from its menu.

usage.title: Find and organize
usage.description: Open My bookmarks to search saved text, rename entries or return to their source conversations.

zh-CN.title: 扩展开发示例
zh-CN.description: 演示中间件、任务生命周期、模型观察器、服务和 HTTP 路由的扩展方式。

usage.title: 安装到开发环境
usage.description: 参考包内文档安装示例，配置并重启 Gateway。它用于演示扩展开发接口。

usage.title: 运行任务并检查统计
usage.description: 执行包含工具调用的任务，再通过示例统计 API 查看调用次数、结果类型与耗时。

en-US.title: Extension development example
en-US.description: Explore middleware, task lifecycle, model observers, services and HTTP route contributions.

usage.title: Install in a development environment
usage.description: Follow the package guide to install, configure and restart Gateway. This package demonstrates extension development contracts.

usage.title: Run a task and inspect statistics
usage.description: Run a task that uses tools, then inspect call counts, outcome types and durations through the example statistics API.

zh-CN.title: 文本分类
zh-CN.description: 按给定类别为文本列表打标签，使用部署方配置的分类服务。

usage.title: 提供文本和分类标准
usage.description: 在对话中提供待分类的文本列表，说明各类别的含义和边界；也可上传表格并指出文本列。

usage.title: 让 Agent 执行分类
usage.description: 要求使用文本分类工具，检查返回标签；如需表格，让 Agent 将标签写回输出文件。

requirements: 管理员已配置 Jev 或兼容聊天接口的分类服务；待分类文本会发送给该服务。

en-US.title: Text classification
en-US.description: Label a list of texts with supplied categories using the deployment-configured classification service.

usage.title: Provide texts and categories
usage.description: Give the Agent a list of texts and explain the categories, or upload a table and identify its text column.

usage.title: Ask the Agent to classify
usage.description: Ask it to use the text classification tool and inspect the labels. For a table, ask it to write labels into an output file.

requirements: An administrator must configure Jev or a compatible chat endpoint. Texts to classify are sent to that service.

zh-CN.title: 上下文裁剪
zh-CN.description: 按需缩短旧的只读工具结果，保留近期消息与原生摘要。

usage.title: 正常进行对话
usage.description: 启用后自动检查长对话中的旧工具输出，不需要打开独立页面或输入额外命令。

usage.title: 达到阈值时自动处理
usage.description: 满足配置的上下文阈值和调用间隔后，裁剪已过时的只读工具结果，保留近期消息和受保护内容。

requirements: 管理员已配置 TypeSafe Jev 服务凭据及触发阈值；处理时会向该服务发送限定范围的对话内容。

en-US.title: Context pruning
en-US.description: Shorten older read-only tool results while preserving recent messages and native summaries.

usage.title: Continue your conversation
usage.description: Once enabled, it automatically checks old tool output in long conversations. No separate page or command is needed.

usage.title: Prune when the threshold is reached
usage.description: After the configured token threshold and call interval, obsolete read-only results are shortened while recent and protected content is retained.

requirements: An administrator must configure TypeSafe Jev credentials and thresholds. Processing sends bounded conversation content to that service.

zh-CN.title: 内容风险提示
zh-CN.description: 检查获取的外部内容，为可疑工具结果添加提示，不阻断工具执行。

usage.title: 按平常方式搜索与读取
usage.description: 启用后，在 Agent 获取网页、搜索或 MCP 工具结果时自动检查部分内容。

usage.title: 结合提示判断内容
usage.description: 检测到可疑指令时，会在工具结果中增加风险提示。它提供提醒，不阻断工具，也不保证识别所有风险。

requirements: 管理员已配置 TypeSafe Jev 服务；待检查的内容片段会发送给该服务。

en-US.title: Content risk warnings
en-US.description: Screen fetched content and add advisory warnings to suspicious tool results without blocking tools.

usage.title: Search and read as usual
usage.description: Once enabled, the middleware checks bounded excerpts of fetched pages, search results and MCP tool output.

usage.title: Review advisory warnings
usage.description: Suspicious instructions add a warning to the tool result. Screening is advisory; it does not block tools or guarantee detection.

requirements: An administrator must configure TypeSafe Jev. Content excerpts are sent to that service for screening.

zh-CN.title: 知识范围选择示例
zh-CN.description: 用示例文档演示知识库和文件范围选择、检索及来源引用。

usage.title: 选择示例知识范围
usage.description: 在对话的知识范围选择器中选择 Synthetic guides，可进一步选择 Synthetic knowledge note。

usage.title: 提问并查看引用
usage.description: 让 Agent 搜索 Cedar，检查回答中的来源引用。此插件使用公开的虚构演示文档。

requirements: 管理员已启用知识检索工具和范围选择，并将工具连接到此示例 Provider。

en-US.title: Knowledge scope example
en-US.description: Search sample documents within selected knowledge bases or files and inspect source citations.

usage.title: Select the example scope
usage.description: Choose Synthetic guides in the chat scope selector, optionally narrowing it to Synthetic knowledge note.

usage.title: Ask and inspect citations
usage.description: Ask the Agent to search for Cedar and inspect its source citations. This example uses a public synthetic document.

requirements: The administrator must enable knowledge retrieval and scope selection and connect the tool to this example provider.

zh-CN.title: 知识中心
zh-CN.description: 在独立页面浏览知识空间、导入资料，并查看文档处理状态。

usage.title: 选择空间与知识库
usage.description: 打开知识中心，选择你有权限访问的空间及其中的知识库。

usage.title: 导入资料
usage.description: 按页面提供的操作导入文件、网址或文本。可用按钮取决于你的权限和服务支持。

usage.title: 查看处理状态
usage.description: 检查返回的文档记录或按文档标识查询状态，必要时手动刷新。

requirements: 已安装并启用知识空间与连接、知识入库与处理扩展，并为你分配可访问的空间和资源。

en-US.title: Knowledge center
en-US.description: Browse knowledge spaces, import content and inspect document processing on a dedicated page.

usage.title: Choose a space and knowledge base
usage.description: Open Knowledge center and select an accessible space and mapped knowledge base.

usage.title: Import content
usage.description: Use the available controls to import a file, URL or text. Controls depend on your permissions and provider support.

usage.title: Inspect processing
usage.description: Inspect the returned document record or look up a document by ID, refreshing its status when needed.

requirements: Enable the knowledge platform and management extensions and grant you access to spaces and resources.

zh-CN.title: 知识入库与处理
zh-CN.description: 导入文件、网址和文本，并查询、管理文档处理任务。

usage.title: 连接已有管理入口
usage.description: 由管理员通过知识中心或管理 API，选择已授权的知识库与操作。此扩展本身提供后台接口。

usage.title: 导入并查询处理结果
usage.description: 提交文件、网址或文本，保留返回的文档标识，再查询处理状态；可用操作由上游能力和权限共同决定。

requirements: 管理员已配置 WeKnora 管理连接及明确的用户、知识库和操作授权。

en-US.title: Knowledge ingestion and processing
en-US.description: Import files, URLs and text, then inspect and manage document processing.

usage.title: Use an existing management entry
usage.description: Use Knowledge center or the management API to select an authorized knowledge base and operation. This extension provides backend endpoints.

usage.title: Ingest and inspect processing
usage.description: Submit a file, URL or text, retain the returned document ID and query its status. Available operations depend on upstream capabilities and permissions.

requirements: The administrator must configure a WeKnora management connection and explicit user, knowledge-base and operation grants.

zh-CN.title: 知识空间与连接
zh-CN.description: 组织知识空间、连接与成员权限，让团队按授权范围使用资料。

usage.title: 由管理员配置空间与资源
usage.description: 通过平台管理接口配置连接、空间成员和可访问资源，明确操作权限。

usage.title: 在授权范围内使用
usage.description: 通过知识中心或平台接口选择可访问的空间和知识库，再进行导入与状态查询。

requirements: 已安装知识入库与处理扩展，并配置连接、持久化存储和空间策略。

en-US.title: Knowledge spaces and connections
en-US.description: Organize knowledge spaces, connections and membership for authorized access.

usage.title: Configure spaces and resources
usage.description: An administrator configures connections, space membership, accessible resources and permitted operations through the platform API.

usage.title: Work within an authorized space
usage.description: Use Knowledge center or platform APIs to select an accessible space and knowledge base, then ingest content or inspect processing.

requirements: Install the knowledge management extension and configure connections, persistent storage and space policies.

zh-CN.title: LightRAG
zh-CN.description: 从 LightRAG 检索文档与实体关系，并使用统一的来源引用。

usage.title: 在对话中提出检索问题
usage.description: 让 Agent 查询已连接知识库中的文档、实体或实体间关系。

usage.title: 查看来源依据
usage.description: 检查结果的文档引用；实体关系只展示服务返回的边，有文档片段支持时才提供对应引用。

requirements: 管理员已配置 LightRAG 连接、凭据、用户绑定和相关检索工具。

en-US.title: LightRAG
en-US.description: Retrieve documents and entity relations from LightRAG with shared source citations.

usage.title: Ask a retrieval question
usage.description: Ask the Agent to search the connected knowledge base for documents, entities or relationships.

usage.title: Inspect supporting sources
usage.description: Check document citations. Relations reflect returned edges and receive document citations only when supporting excerpts are available.

requirements: The administrator must configure the LightRAG connection, credentials, user bindings and retrieval tools.

zh-CN.title: 分段长文写作
zh-CN.description: 逐段撰写长报告，并将各章节汇总为可下载的 Markdown 文档。

usage.title: 在对话里提出写作任务
usage.description: 告诉 Agent 报告主题、目标读者和章节要求，并要求使用分段长文写作工具。

usage.title: 先定大纲，再逐章完成
usage.description: 让 Agent 先保存大纲，再逐章撰写和保存。需要修改时，在同一对话中指出要修改的章节。

usage.title: 汇总并下载
usage.description: 全部章节完成后，让 Agent 合并报告；在对话的文件成果中下载 Markdown 文档。

en-US.title: Sectioned long-form writing
en-US.description: Write long reports section by section and assemble them into a downloadable Markdown document.

usage.title: Describe the report in chat
usage.description: Tell the Agent the topic, audience and chapter requirements, and ask it to use the sectioned writing tool.

usage.title: Outline, then write each chapter
usage.description: Ask the Agent to save an outline, then write and save chapters one at a time. Request chapter revisions in the same conversation.

usage.title: Assemble and download
usage.description: Ask the Agent to assemble the finished chapters, then download the Markdown document from the conversation artifacts.

zh-CN.title: 本地检索示例
zh-CN.description: 使用固定示例文档演示只读检索与结构化工具结果，不连接外部知识库。

usage.title: 在对话里试一次检索
usage.description: 让 Agent 使用本地检索示例搜索 release，查看匹配到的固定演示文档。

usage.title: 检查返回结果
usage.description: 观察文字摘要与结构化工具成果；示例数据是虚构的，不代表真实知识库内容。

en-US.title: Local retrieval example
en-US.description: Demonstrate read-only retrieval and structured tool results using fixed sample documents, without an external knowledge service.

usage.title: Try a search in chat
usage.description: Ask the Agent to use the local retrieval example to search for release and inspect the matching demonstration document.

usage.title: Inspect the result
usage.description: Review its text summary and structured tool artifact. The fixed corpus is synthetic, not a real knowledge base.

zh-CN.title: WeKnora 知识检索
zh-CN.description: 检索 WeKnora 知识库和所选文档，并展示来源引用。

usage.title: 选择检索范围
usage.description: 在对话中选择已授权的 WeKnora 知识库，按需缩小到具体文档。

usage.title: 提问并核对来源
usage.description: 提出与已入库资料相关的问题，查看返回片段和来源引用。

requirements: 已有完成索引的 WeKnora 知识库；管理员已配置连接、凭据、用户授权和检索工具。

en-US.title: WeKnora knowledge retrieval
en-US.description: Search WeKnora knowledge bases and selected documents with source citations.

usage.title: Select a search scope
usage.description: Choose an authorized WeKnora knowledge base in chat and narrow it to specific documents when needed.

usage.title: Ask and verify sources
usage.description: Ask a question about indexed content and inspect the retrieved excerpts and source citations.

requirements: An indexed WeKnora knowledge base is required, with an administrator-configured connection, credentials, user grants and retrieval tool.

zh-CN.title: 脚本工作流
zh-CN.description: 运行可检查的 Agent 脚本工作流，跟踪步骤进度，并按保留版本确认成果。

usage.title: 打开脚本工作流
usage.description: 进入工作流页面，准备一个受支持的 JavaScript 工作流及其输入参数。

usage.title: 提交并查看执行过程
usage.description: 启动后查看步骤进度、Agent 子会话和执行结果；需要人工确认的步骤会等待你的处理。

usage.title: 按保留版本确认成果
usage.description: 检查实际保留的输出版本，再确认或继续工作流。重启恢复取决于工作流和部署是否支持。

requirements: 管理员已配置可调用的 Agent 和持久化存储；Gateway 运行在 Linux 或 macOS。

en-US.title: Script workflows
en-US.description: Run inspectable Agent workflows, track steps and review retained output versions.

usage.title: Open Script workflows
usage.description: Open the workflow page and prepare a supported JavaScript workflow and its input arguments.

usage.title: Run and inspect
usage.description: Start the workflow and inspect steps, Agent conversations and results. Human checkpoints wait for your response.

usage.title: Review retained output
usage.description: Inspect the retained output version before approving or continuing. Restart recovery depends on workflow and deployment compatibility.

requirements: The administrator must configure allowed Agents and persistent storage on a Linux or macOS Gateway.
